metadata.name: Run History
metadata.description:
[h1]Run History / 对局记录[/h1] Records your last 20 runs and shows them on a page styled like the game's own paper menus. (中文说明在下面)
[h2]What it records[/h2] [b]Every run[/b] [list] [*]Character, seed, difficulty, result (win / death / quit), run time [*]Final items, final active items and trinkets, final stats [*]The last boss you beat [*]What killed you (enemy or boss with its death-screen portrait, or spikes, curse doors, self-damage...) [/list] [b]Every floor[/b] [list] [*]Items picked up, bosses beaten (with icons), time spent [*]Coins, bombs and keys when you left the floor [*]Whether a devil / angel room appeared and whether you went in [/list]
[h2]How to open[/h2] [list] [*]During a run: press [b]F2[/b] (change it in rh_config.lua) [*]Main menu: with [url=https://github.com/TeamREPENTOGON/REPENTOGON]REPENTOGON[/url] installed, a "Run History" note appears in the Stats screen. Without REPENTOGON everything else still works. [*]In the floor view, press [b]Space[/b] to browse items and see their names and pickup text. [/list]
[h2]Compatibility[/h2] [list] [*]Made and tested on [b]Repentance v1.7.9b[/b]. [b]Not tested on Repentance+.[/b] [*]The main-menu entry was tested with REPENTOGON 1.0.12e (the last version for v1.7.9b). [*]English and Chinese UI; other languages show English. [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] [list] [*]History is saved per save slot in data/run history/ and is not synced by Steam Cloud. [*]Opening the page during a run stops your character, but enemies keep moving. Open it in a cleared room. [*]Stats, active items and trinkets are recorded for player 1 only. [*]Greed mode records only the final Ultra Greed, not the wave bosses. [*]Enemies from other mods have no portrait; their names need External Item Descriptions. [/list]
[h1]对局记录[/h1] 自动记录最近 20 局对局，用游戏自己的纸张菜单风格显示。
[h2]记录内容[/h2] [b]每局[/b]：角色、种子、难度、结果（胜利 / 死亡 / 放弃）、用时；最终道具、最后的主动道具和饰品、最终属性；最后击败的 Boss；死因（敌人或 Boss 的死亡画面头像，或尖刺、诅咒房门、自伤等）。 [b]每层[/b]：获得的道具、击败的 Boss（带图标）、本层用时、离开时的金币 / 炸弹 / 钥匙、恶魔房 / 天使房是否出现、是否进入。
[h2]怎么打开[/h2] [list] [*]对局中按 [b]F2[/b]（可在 rh_config.lua 里修改） [*]装有 [url=https://github.com/TeamREPENTOGON/REPENTOGON]REPENTOGON[/url] 时，主菜单"统计数据"里会多出一张"对局记录"便签；没装也不影响其他功能 [*]在楼层详情页按 [b]空格[/b] 逐个查看道具的官方名称和拾取说明 [/list]
[h2]适用版本[/h2] [list] [*]在 [b]忏悔 v1.7.9b[/b] 上开发和测试，[b]没有在忏悔+ 上测试过[/b] [*]菜单入口在 REPENTOGON 1.0.12e（支持 v1.7.9b 的最后一个版本）上测试 [/list]
[h2]说明[/h2] [list] [*]记录按存档槽分开保存在 data/run history/，不走 Steam 云同步 [*]对局内打开页面时角色不会动，但敌人不会暂停，建议在清完的房间里看 [*]属性、主动和饰品只记录 1 号角色 [*]贪婪模式只记录最后的究极贪婪，不记录每波的 Boss [*]其他 mod 加的敌人没有头像，名字需要装 EID 才能显示 [/list]
